Like how it be calculated from the front-end when creating a pool. I have played the demo site, there are 2 range sliders, one is the price in ETH and another one is the NFT amount. How that reflect to these variables?\n+\n+\n+[04/09/2023 10:36] out.eth (pinned)\n+The calculation in the frontend to match the price range a user defines uses a decent amount of math that imo is out of scope - if you would really find it interesting I can post it in here. But I think a high level intuition serves to explain more clearly:\n+\n+1. A user selects a price range at which they want to deposit liquidity in the UI\n+2. They select some NFTs and some ETH that they want to deposit, and also define an initial price\n+3. we want to find a `virtualNftReserves` and `virtualBaseTokenReserves` that:\n+  a) has the initial price that the user defined\n+  b) will reach the top of the price range if all the NFTs are bought from the pool\n+  c) will reach the bottom of the price range if all the ETH is used to buy NFTs that are sold into the pool\n+\n+\n+[04/09/2023 10:50] t.nero\n+Great, thanks.\n+1 more question: By the term \"top\" and \"bottom\" of the price range, does it mean either `virtualNftReserves = 0` or `virtualBaseTokenReserves = 0`?\n+\n+\n+[04/09/2023 10:52] out.eth\n+The top of the price range's value is when there are 0 NFTs in the contract, the value of virtualBaseTokenReserves / virtualNftReserves\n+The bottom of the price range's value is when there is 0 ETH left in the contract, the value of virtualBaseTokenReserves / virtualNftReserves\n+\n+{Reactions}\n+🙌 (2) \n+\n+[04/09/2023 10:54] t.nero\n+Thank you.\n+\n+\n+[04/09/2023 11:53] devabdee\n+What is the overall test coverage around?\n+\n+\n+[04/09/2023 11:54] dingo2077\n+@out.eth dmed u\n+\n+\n+[04/09/2023 12:36] bason91\n+@out.eth, \n+I have a questions related to this code: \n+```if ((_baseToken == address(0) && msg.value != baseTokenAmount) || (_baseToken != address(0) && msg.value > 0)) {\n+            revert PrivatePool.InvalidEthAmount();\n+        }\n+```\n+Why are we reverting if the base token is different from address 0 and we are receiving some eth?\n+\n+\n+[04/09/2023 13:32] t.nero\n+Because an ERC20 is expected not ETH, and the caller attach ETH during the call for no reason.\n+\n+{Reactions}\n+👍 (2) \n+\n+[04/09/2023 14:17] bason91\n+@Kenshin , @out.eth , and what is the virtual base token reserve used for?
